name: What is the difference between an egress basement door and a standard one?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between an egress basement door and a standard one?

acceptedAnswer.text: An egress basement door is specifically designed and installed to meet local building codes for emergency exit, typically providing a clear opening large enough for someone to escape in case of fire or other emergencies. These often lead to an egress well. A standard basement door might provide access but not necessarily meet the specific size or accessibility requirements for emergency egress. If your basement is a living space (e.g., bedroom), an egress compliant door is often legally required for safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: An egress door meets specific building codes for emergency exit, offering a clear opening for safety. A standard door provides access but may not meet egress requirements.
